name: Implicit Bipartition via Directed Layering
description: Replaced the explicit "two operational groups" guarantee with a logically equivalent but heavily disguised structural property: the edges can be directed such that no vertex has both in-degree > 0 and out-degree > 0. Models that rely on keyword matching or explicit partition descriptions will fail to recognize the graph as bipartite and will likely attempt a general NP-hard MIS algorithm, resulting in a Time Limit Exceeded.
